Test PR #81 (feature/sfcc-731-pdp-gallery -> develop) for the Zimmermann PWA Kit. This is a large PR (34 files, +3281/-475) implementing a PDP product gallery (`ZimmProductGallery`), a full-screen gallery overlay (`ZimmGalleryOverlay`), a shared media tile (`ZimmMediaTile`), PDP hero full-bleed layout changes, and colour-swatch group changes. It has already been through ~5 rounds of CodeRabbit review with fixes applied; CodeRabbit's final state is APPROVED.

Local worktrees are ready for you to read/run against — do not re-clone or re-checkout:
- Head (PR tip, commit 6284ea3): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-marcel-a-n-navarro-Dev-zimmermann-pwa/37973080-8be5-46e1-9aab-e2abcb81ea17/scratchpad/pr81-head (node_modules symlinked, ready to run)

- Full diff: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-marcel-a-n-navarro-Dev-zimmermann-pwa/37973080-8be5-46e1-9aab-e2abcb81ea17/scratchpad/pr81/pr81.diff

GATES ALREADY MEASURED — do NOT re-run tsc/lint/test/audit:tokens, treat these as settled fact:
- tsc --noEmit: clean on both head and base (exit 0)
- lint: base has 5 errors/21 warnings (all in overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.test.ts, a file this PR does NOT touch), head has 4 errors/21 warnings in the same untouched file — 100% pre-existing debt, not attributable to this PR, do not report it
- audit:tokens: both base and head report exactly 2 unacknowledged violations, identical files/lines (footer/footer.css.ts:20, theme/components/zimmDrawerShared.ts:12) — zero new unacknowledged violations from this PR. Two new raw values in the PR's own new file (zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts:15 '45rem', :104 '6.375rem') land in the "acknowledged exception" bucket already — worth a quick look at whether the comment justifying that acknowledgement is legitimate (real "provisional/pending" reasoning) rather than gaming the script, but this is not a fresh violation.
- vitest: base 46 files/695 tests passed, head 52 files/768 tests passed — +6 files/+73 tests, all green both sides, no regressions.
- Two CodeRabbit-flagged bugs (MediaTile image-error state keyed on boolean not source; selectedIndex not clamped when media array shrinks) were fixed in later commits — I already spot-checked the current head code and confirmed both fixes are genuinely present (`erroredSrc` state compared against `src`, `safeSelectedIndex = Math.min(selectedIndex, Math.max(0, media.length - 1))`). Don't re-litigate these two as open bugs, but DO check if the same class of bug (state keyed by index/boolean instead of identity, unclamped index math) recurs anywhere else in the new components.

Dispatch your own sub-agents across angles appropriate to a PR this size. Suggested angles (adjust as you see fit):
1. **Correctness & regression** — focus especially on: the desktop layout variant logic (`getDesktopLayoutCounts.ts` — pure function claiming to implement 5 stated AC cases for 3/4/5/6/7+ media items, check the boundary cases and the "+1 held back rather than uneven 3-cell row" claim for the 5-item case); the duplicate-eager-fetch fix (claims compact carousel's first tile is now always lazy while desktop keeps eager); the `#app-main` flex-stretch fix in globalStyles.ts (claims explicit `width: '100%'` fixes a shrink-to-fit bug — verify the CSS reasoning holds and doesn't regress other pages that also use `#app-main`, since this is a **global**, not gallery-scoped, style change); inert/focus-trap correctness for non-active carousel slides; the aria-live region wording change.
2. **Conventions, structure, tier ownership** — this PR touches two Tier 2 areas per protectedFiles.md: `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (Theme Component Styles, UI-designer owned) and modifies colour swatch components that are shared. Check `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md`'s styling hierarchy is followed (var(--zimm-*) not bare token keys, textStyle not raw fontSize) in all the new files (zimmProductGallery, zimmGalleryOverlay, zimmMediaTile, and the zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatchGroup changes). Check AGENTS.md Hard Rule 5 ("never refactor upward") and Hard Rule 6 ("never rename/move a shared hook or component") aren't violated by the ZimmMediaTile extraction (was it cleanly new, or did it rip logic out of something else in a way that changed that thing's public contract?). Check the new `ZimmButton` `sx` prop addition (`zimmButton/index.tsx`, +6/-2) is genuinely additive/backward-compatible as the commit claims, not a structural change to a shared atom used everywhere.
3. **Contract fidelity** — `zimmColourSwatchGroup`/`zimmColourSwatch` are reused by both the existing PDP colour selector AND the new overlay. Check the new `circle` variant and `appendColon` prop don't change default (square-variant, PDP) behaviour — i.e. purely additive. Also check `product-view/index.tsx`'s claimed combining of "natural same-master variants" with SFCC-708's `c_relatedSwatches` matches what `product-detail/index.tsx` already does for its own "Colour:" group (the PR claims these now match exactly — verify).
4. **Failure modes & security** — image error handling (fallback rendering, aria-hidden on the empty-alt fallback), any use of `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` (should be none here, confirm), the new Contentful uiCopy key handling if uiCopy is missing/loading, DIS image URL construction (`buildDisImageSrc.ts` — new util, check it validates/encodes rather than blindly interpolating into a URL).
5. **Token/styling & test-coverage strategy** — new z-index constants (claimed named instead of magic numbers), the zimmButton.css.ts TODO left for the `sizes.lg` textStyle bug (confirm it's flagged, not silently worked around in a way that masks the real shared-recipe bug elsewhere), and whether test coverage in the 6 new test files actually exercises the edge cases their own PR commits claim to fix (e.g. is there a real regression test for the single-image "+N" button suppression, the image-error-recovery-on-new-source case, and the media-shrink clamp case) rather than just happy-path coverage.

Do NOT do visual/Figma/browser design-fidelity checks — that's being handled separately by the human reviewer directly. Focus entirely on code-level correctness, conventions, and test quality. Report findings with file:line, and be explicit about which are CONFIRMED (you reproduced/traced it in the actual code) vs suspected (say what's missing to confirm). I will independently verify your findings before any of them get used, so don't inflate confidence.

3	 * base SFCC's `getResponsivePictureAttributes`/`DynamicImage` expect (see
4	 * `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/responsive-image.js`'s own `getSrc` doc comment):
5	 * a `[...]` segment containing a `{width}` placeholder that gets swapped in per breakpoint via
6	 * SFCC's Dynamic Imaging Service query params (`sw` = scale width, `q` = quality).
7	 *
8	 * Deliberately does not build the `<picture>`/`srcSet` logic itself — that already exists in
9	 * `DynamicImage` and shouldn't be duplicated. This is only the one SFCC-specific piece missing
10	 * from that generic utility: the actual DIS query string for a given image URL.
11	 *
12	 * `data:`/`blob:` URLs are returned unchanged, with no template wrapper — DIS server-side
13	 * resizing is meaningless for a URL that already *is* the image bytes (there's no server to ask),
14	 * and appending a query-string-shaped suffix to a base64 payload corrupts it outright (the
15	 * browser fails to decode it, `net::ERR_INVALID_URL`) rather than merely doing nothing useful.
16	 *
17	 * @param url - Raw SFCC image URL (`disBaseLink` or `link`), with or without existing query params.
18	 * @param quality - DIS `q` param (0-100). Defaults to 80 — user-confirmed as the right baseline
19	 *   for this brand's product photography (2026-09-05); 60, the base SFCC image-gallery
20	 *   component's own default, showed visible compression artifacts on fabric/detail shots.
21	 * @returns A templated src ready for `DynamicImage`'s `src` prop or base's `getSrc` helper.
22	 */
23	export const buildDisImageSrc = (url: string, quality = 80): string => {
24	  if (url.startsWith('data:') || url.startsWith('blob:')) return url;
25	  const separator = url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
26	  return `${url}[${separator}sw={width}&q=${quality}]`;
